# Test Plan Template

## Scope

Describe the behavior and risks covered by this plan.

## Test levels

List unit, integration, API, contract, end-to-end, and manual checks as applicable.

## Cases

Describe key happy paths, edge cases, and failure cases.

## Data

Describe test data, fixtures, and reset needs.

## Automation

List automated commands and expected gates.

## Residual risk

Call out what remains untested and why.
